name: Kounotori 8 gouki
about: Kounotori 8 gouki (2019-062A), a crewed vehicle (HTV), launched 2019 Sep 24. One orbit from GCAT's satcat (shape and inclination; orientation estimated), then how that phase ended (GRP).

pieces.why: GCAT gives the orbit's shape and inclination, not its orientation or where along it the craft was; the orbit is GCAT's at its epoch (2019 Sep 26), held fixed
docked to A06499; GCAT's tables give no later phase (undocking, landing)
